$description: Terminal capsule contextual interaction surface (prose: terminal-capsule.md). The capsule carries the Session's direct terminal input plus contextual capability interaction — it is not a permanent toolbar, and a capability earns presence by context rather than by registration. The measurable fields constrain the chrome band: single line, control.md density, overflow collapses into a popover (web) / sheet (app). radiusToken / padXToken / maxWidthToken carry §Visual contract's 'capsule radius from semantic design tokens', 'exact spacing and alignment', and the Web placement row's 'bounded max width' — the three parts of that section that are measurable, promoted from prose so they can fail.
